name: Finale Inventory
description_en:
Descartes Finale combines inventory management, ecommerce channel connections, procurement and inventory-related financial reporting. Its warehouse offering includes an optional mobile barcode WMS module, with receiving, picking, counts and transfers.

The practical evaluation is an order-and-stock reconciliation exercise across channels and warehouses. The current plan structure matters because mobile WMS, API/EDI access and premium service commitments are not presented identically across tiers.
description_zh:
Descartes Finale 结合库存管理、电商渠道连接、采购及库存相关财务报表，仓库方案包括移动条码 WMS 模块，用于收货、拣货、盘点和转移。

实际评估应核对跨渠道与跨仓库的订单和库存。当前方案结构很重要，移动 WMS、API/EDI 和高级服务承诺在不同版本中并非相同。

sections.title_en: Test channel aliases and warehouse execution together
sections.title_zh: 同时测试渠道别名与仓库执行
sections.en: Map channel SKUs or aliases to the actual stocked product, receive a purchase and fulfill a multi-line order with scanning. Compare the warehouse balance, channel availability and landed-cost reporting. Include a lot-controlled item or bundle if used operationally. A guided pick is useful only when product identifiers, bins and opening quantities are correct.
sections.zh: 将渠道 SKU 或别名映射到实物商品，采购收货后用扫描完成多行订单，再比较仓库余额、渠道可售数量和到岸成本报表。如果业务涉及批次商品或套装，也应加入测试。引导拣货依赖正确的商品标识、仓位和期初数量。

sections.title_en: Check the mobile WMS and API package
sections.title_zh: 检查移动 WMS 与 API 包含范围
sections.en: Essentials and Growth share documented central inventory, multichannel connections, procurement and financial reporting. Growth explicitly includes the Mobile Barcode WMS module; Enterprise includes that module, API/EDI access and premium SLAs/account management. The all-features list describes the wider product, so it should not override these package distinctions.
sections.zh: Essentials 与 Growth 均列出中心库存、多渠道连接、采购及财务报表。Growth 明确包含移动条码 WMS；Enterprise 包含该模块、API/EDI 及高级 SLA 和客户经理。全功能清单描述整体产品，不能覆盖这些套餐差异。

sections.title_en: Use starting prices rather than universal quotes
sections.title_zh: 将公布金额理解为起价
sections.en: Essentials starts at $499 per month and Growth at $799; Enterprise is custom-priced. Public capacity statements such as up to 300 users or 1.5 million monthly orders describe potential specialized deployments, not included entry-tier quotas. All plans describe onboarding/support, with premium terms on Enterprise. Confirm scanners, labels, onboarding scope and any extra volume charges. The FAQ says most customers choose 12-, 24- or 36-month agreements; extra usage can incur fees or an upgrade. Standard onboarding is included, while advanced QuickBooks consulting can cost extra.
sections.zh: Essentials 从每月 $499 起，Growth 从 $799 起，Enterprise 定制询价。最多 300 用户或每月 150 万订单等公开容量描述适用于潜在专门部署，不能视为入门版内含额度。所有方案说明上线与支持，Enterprise 有高级条款。应确认扫描设备、标签、上线范围和额外量费用。 FAQ 说明多数客户选择 12、24 或 36 个月协议；额外使用量可能收费或要求升级。标准上线包含在内，进阶 QuickBooks 咨询可能另计。

sections.en: Growing ecommerce operations needing stronger warehouse execution can evaluate Finale. Test partial receipts, a wrong-item scan, returns and a failed channel update, and reconcile financial values with the accounting system. The vendor’s suggested 2–6 week go-live is an estimate, not a measured delivery promise for this business. No scanner or live integration was operated.
sections.zh: 需要更强仓库执行的成长型电商可评估 Finale。应测试部分收货、错扫商品、退货和渠道更新失败，并与会计系统核对财务价值。厂商建议的 2–6 周上线属于估计，非针对本企业的实测交付承诺。未实际操作扫描器或线上集成。
